{{Top|leg}}
'''Composite heavy plating''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] system that sacrificed mobility in favor of bulk. The huge composite plates that covered the droid did not allow for the range of motion that other armor systems may have had, but in terms of physical protection, this plating was the best in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
